1879061010.name: Sneak
1879061010.desc: Move about unseen while Sneaking.\n\nThere is a chance enemies will detect you, especially when you move in front of them.

1879064082.name: Eagle's Cry
1879064082.desc: This fellowship skill replenishes your morale and can contribute to fellowship manoeuvres.

1879064338.name: Ready and Able
1879064338.desc: Resets the recovery timers on several skills.\n\nUsing this skill will not break Stealth.

1879072530.name: Hamstring
1879072530.desc: You cut the legs of your foe, slowing their movement.

1879073298.name: Wide Provoke
1879073298.desc: Deal modest damage, but improves the likelihood of a critical hit on your next attack.

1879091730.name: Time of Need
1879091730.desc:
You gain a surge of energy for a short time.

Puts you in a Battle-readied State.

Increases your damage output for a short time.

1879097874.name: Imposing Presence
1879097874.desc: Your presence inspires your allies with greater strength; mostly through fear.

1879136786.name: Steadfast Barrage
1879136786.desc: You focus all of your ranged fire on a single opponent. You cannot move or perform any other actions while in this state. Barraging attacks cannot critical and they cannot miss, be blocked, evaded, or parried.

1879198354.name: Friend of the Wilds (Tundra-guardian)
1879198354.desc: Summons a Bog-guardian companion.\n\nThe Bog-guardian excels at dealing damage from range.

1879208722.name: Foul Blast
1879208722.desc: Lilacs, vanilla, freshly baked cookies. These are NOT the types of smells this item will create.

1879232402.name: Ranged Persevere
1879232402.desc: A shield strike, which heals you over time and increases incoming healing.

procEffects.description: When enemies Block, Parry, or Evade your attacks, you have a chance of quickly following up from another angle, dealing:

1879239570.name: Noble Arrow
1879239570.desc: The Noble Arrow, once launched, will seek to injure your foe with critical intent.

1879241490.name: Valiant Strike
1879241490.desc: A strike that instantly heals the Morale of your Shield-brother.

conditionalEffects.description: Critical Events Increase your Melee Damage by 3%.
Critical Events Increase your Melee Damage by 6%.

1879259922.name: Trick: Impugn Character
1879259922.desc: You strike out at your foe with a cunning trick.

1879260306.name: Radiant Blast
1879260306.desc: You hurl a lens toward your target distracting and potentially dismounting them. The glimmering light will attract a murder of crows to hamper the target's movement once the distraction dissipates.\n\n<rgb=#ff6600>This skill cannot be used on a target under the effects of 'Murder of Crows' the movement reducing effect applied by Radiant Burst.</rgb>

1879270546.name: Barrage 2
1879270546.desc: A quick attack that deals more damage each time it is used.

conditionalEffects.description: Ranged Focus Spenders increase your Ranged Damage until your next Ranged Focus Builder.

1879275154.name: Deadly Decoy
1879275154.desc: Drops an explosive decoy that draws the attention of nearby foes. When it explodes, it will damage and stun enemies.

1879324050.name: Ginger Cat
1879324050.desc: Summons a cat to keep you company.

1879329170.name: Striped Pelennor Pig
1879329170.desc: Summons a pig to keep you company.

1879366930.name: Goat of Erebor's Royal Guard
1879366930.desc: A goat clad in the raiment of Erebor's royal guard.

1879387922.name: Return to Beorninghús
1879387922.desc: Thanks to your friendship with the Beornings, you're able to quickly return to Beorninghús. This skill is easily interrupted.

1879391250.name: Fortitude of the Stout-axes
1879391250.desc: You spent many years in the shadow of the Dark Lord. You are able to inspire your Fellowship to resist Shadow.

1879416082.name: Return to Trestlebridge
1879416082.desc: You're able to quickly return to Trestlebridge. This skill is easily interrupted.

1879419538.name: Return to Azanulbizar
1879419538.desc: You're able to quickly return to Azanulbizar. This skill is easily interrupted.

1879422226.name: Defensive Posture
1879422226.desc: Adopt a defensive posture, decreasing incoming damage at the cost of offensive capability.\nOnly one Posture may be active at a time.

1879451154.name: Cleansing Shadows
1879451154.desc: Summon tendrils of shadow, cleansing you of up to three non-physical effects and healing you for each effect consumed.

1879457554.name: Ranged Cauterizing Steel
1879457554.desc:
A series of precision strikes hit your opponent with a red-hot weapon where already wounded.

This skill will consume any Power Attack, Mighty Blow, or Unerring Strike damage over time effects on your target, dealing bonus damage for each effect consumed.

<rgb=#FF7700>Using will restore this skill to Battle Memory.</rgb>

conditionalEffects.description: The Cauterizing Steel Gambit line will apply a 10% Incoming Healing debuff to the target. Stacks once.
The Cauterizing Steel Gambit line will apply a 10% Incoming Healing debuff to the target. Stacks up to 2 times.
The Cauterizing Steel Gambit line will apply a 10% Incoming Healing debuff to the target. Stacks up to 3 times.

1879465490.name: Black Draught Horse
1879465490.desc: Summons a strong horse to accompany you on your journeys.

1879466258.name: Thrust
1879466258.desc:
A quick forward thrust.

<rgb=#FF7700>Swordplay:
 Improves Single Target Skill Damage.
 Aggressive Strike deals more damage.
 Advance deals more damage.</rgb>
<rgb=#FF0000> Advance applies a bleed.</rgb>

1879475986.name: Muster at Dol Amroth, King's Gondor
1879475986.desc: Allows the Warden to travel to Dol Amroth in King's Gondor.

1879488018.name: Wizard's Spark
1879488018.desc: A basic sigil which shocks your foe.\n\nIf this skill is used whilst your companion flanks the enemy, your Speed will be increased.

procEffects.description: DNT - Wild Sigils reduce the active cooldown of Sign of the Wild: Rage

1879501842.name: Shield of Blood
1879501842.desc: Steal Kormoltur's power and shield your allies from his whisper of blood.\n\n<rgb=#00ff00>The mushroom will explode when dropped.</rgb>

1879506578.name: Wisp of Shadow
1879506578.desc: Servants of the Umbral Pall use wisps of shadow to harm their enemies.<rgb=#00ffff>\n\nCan be prepared as a Sorcerous Study.</rgb>

conditionalEffects.description: Shadow Wisp, Spike, and Breath gain the ability to tier up the Seeing Shadows effect if present, up to Tier 3.

1879517202.name: Fall Hobby-broom
1879517202.desc: A creative Harvestmath toy.\n\nYou may ride it in most towns and cities.

1879521298.name: Brown Mûmak Calf
1879521298.desc: Summons a brown mûmak calf to accompany you on your travels.
